description: Randomized UR5/Panda workspace scenes with blocked straight-line start-goal pairs.
baseline_note: Exp.5 reuses Exp.4's paper SBF build/cached-query architecture, records build and query times separately, and performs an untimed per-scene LECT prewarm before SBF measurement. PRM build is sampling plus roadmap construction; PRM query is Dijkstra plus shortcut. IRIS/GCS proxy build is skeleton generation plus local region inflation; query is shortest-chain extraction plus shortcut. BIT* is reported as a fixed 2s query budget with no reusable build phase. OMPL and IRIS/GCS rows remain local reproducible proxies for the random URDF scenes; Exp.4 Marcucci baselines use the v6-native Drake/OMPL runners.
